topics.text: Rooms are generally described as spacious with comfortable bedding, and some guests appreciated specific amenities like large balconies with panoramic views. The overall design of the hotel is appealing to those who enjoy being close to nature.

Located conveniently for exploring the surrounding area, the hotel offers easy access to local attractions. The proximity to nature and the ability to enjoy quiet, scenic walks are frequently praised.

While there are mixed reviews on service, some guests reported helpful and friendly staff who provided assistance during their stay. Instances of room upgrades and responsive service during emergencies were appreciated by guests.

suggestion.text: Some customers suggest improving service efficiency and addressing hygiene issues.

address: No. 117 Zhuyuan Road, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313202, China
